title: Authenticator reuse across systems needs a deployment risk review
remediation: The deployment identity risk owner identifies where the same individuals hold accounts on multiple assessed systems and obtains sponsor approval of measures to limit cross-system compromise. Collect a redacted account and service inventory, approved authenticator reuse controls and operating evidence for the selected mechanism. Sample that independent credentials, centrally managed sign-in or another approved mechanism operates as designed. Record inherited coverage and route unmitigated reuse to its operator.

milestones.title: Review multi-system account scope, approve reuse safeguards and retain a redacted account sample and evidence that the chosen safeguards operate
